intro: An original fantasy MMORPG, built as an experiment with Claude Code. Made with Godot Engine (MIT licence; see Godot-LICENSE and Godot-COPYRIGHT below).

assets.asset: Polyfork characters (19): Human Warrior, Knight, Assassin, Mage and Priest; Elf Hunter, Assassin and Mage; Dwarf Knight, Berserker and Priest; Halfling Hunter, Assassin and Monk; Orc Warrior, Hunter and Berserker; Gnome Mage and Warrior. Their own clips replaced by retargeted Quaternius clips (see the pack's LICENSE.txt for every change). Used for every player race, gender and armour type. Credit: "<Name> by Polyfork, CC BY 4.0" for each.
assets.author: Polyfork

assets.asset: Polyfork monsters and townsfolk (43): skeletons, revenant and order knights, ghosts, trolls, golems, treants, cultists, bandits, kobolds, bog fiends and other swamp folk, and the town merchants, guards, smiths and villagers; each listed in the pack's LICENSE.txt. Their own clips replaced by 11 retargeted Quaternius clips. Used for most mobs, pets and NPCs (picked in tools/model_picks.py).
assets.author: Polyfork

assets.asset: Polyfork animals (19): wolf, ember hound, rat, thorn-backed boar, stag beetle, ant queen, shore crab, tarantula, orb weaver, crow, owl, herring gull, crypt bat, red fire dragonling, red fire, purple flame and crystal dragons, crocodile, stone centipede, each listed in the pack's LICENSE.txt, unchanged, with their own animations. Used for the beasts, insects, birds and drakes.
assets.author: Polyfork

assets.asset: Polyfork environment parts (112) from the kits alpine-and-snow, campground-lake, coast-and-boardwalk, cozy-farm, dragons-lair-dark-dragon, halloween-night, loot-lode-kit, medieval-village-kit, nature-forest-kit, pirate-cove: trees, rocks, plants, village buildings, walls, a forge and stalls, snow and alpine pieces, dragon-lair rocks, crystals and bones, graveyard pieces, docks and boats, mine pieces. Each is listed in the folder's LICENSE.txt, unchanged. Used for every zone prop (tools/world_skins.py), ground clutter and dungeon decorations (content/environments.json).
assets.author: Polyfork

assets.asset: Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 [Standard]: 25 clips (idle, walk, run, sword attacks, casting, hit, death, sitting and others), retargeted onto the Polyfork characters. The source files are not shipped.
